description: Word Header & Footer Accessibility Assistant is an NVDA add-on that improves access to Microsoft Word headers and footers for blind and visually impaired users. It provides commands to read and edit the current section's header and footer, including support for first-page and odd/even page variants where available.
changelog: Added commands to read and edit the current Microsoft Word section's header and footer. Added support for first-page and odd/even page variants where available. Improved Microsoft Word integration and user-facing messages.
